regions.today: Very warm and dry across Leinster with plenty of sunshine this afternoon and evening,coolest along the east coast and warmest in the midlands, with light northeast or variable breezes.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry with clear spells and possibly some patches of mist and fog. Lowest temperatures of 12 to 15 degrees in light to moderate northerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Friday will be dry with sunny spells and light to moderate northerly breezes. Highest temperatures of 24 to 28 degrees, warmest in the south of the region.
